scope: Natural contact-led clearance mission-route handback after safe partial search
finding: Terminal clearance correctly reports INCOMPLETE for inaccessible/unvisited rooms, but opt-in continuation also required full COMPLETE. Safely settled actors after a finite partial search could remain held on an unchanged authored MOVE solely because coverage was incomplete. This is source policy evidence, not a reproduced physical stop.
change: Allow COMPLETE or INCOMPLETE under existing natural completion reason, continueRoute opt-in and nonfailed egress. Result/coverage publication unchanged. Exact original plain ungated MOVE/native receipt, current operation retirement, actor STOP/post availability, owner/generation, existing formation chain and external-control checks remain. Explicit CLEAR default continuation false unchanged.
intent: Finite incidental clearance should relinquish its interruption of mission movement when actors safely exit; returning to original mission movement is not proof the house is safe. An inaccessible modded node must not itself grant permanent route ownership.

validation.counterexample: 4/5 physically visited nodes produce INCOMPLETE; safe opted-in handback now eligible, explicit/no-opt-in, failed egress and changed route still refuse.

limits: No actual inaccessible-building continuation, native acknowledgement/travel, threat response after return, repeat, normal/HC or performance proof. Existing no-replay native handback limitations remain. No claim this resolves historical sprawl/exit screenshots. Unsigned dirty candidate includes unrelated preexisting dirt; review/handover postdate package. No source-parity/build percentage credit.
